memo_delta.stage_one_comment: Delivery Hero remains a review of the original Avoid call, with current action Stay away. Confirmed offer terms and a stronger earnings outlook weaken parts of the original bearish case. The planned Taiwan sale failed regulatory approval, which supports caution about expected debt reduction. The cash-flow outlook still excludes certain legal payments, so it cannot settle the original forecast about unadjusted cash generation. Two early forecasts remain inconclusive, one document-publication forecast is confirmed, and three longer forecasts remain open. The November 5 acceptance deadline has passed, but this review has not established an acceptance-result notice or completed takeover. A dated Xetra close allows an indicative price comparison; a matched benchmark return is missing, so no relative-performance or skill claim follows. Keep the original decision and model unchanged, and verify the outstanding terms, cash flows and auditor language before reconsidering entry.
